set.body: From S4.5a review. (1) The table is AccessibleRole.PARENT with cursor-row text only; StudioPanes maps Table panes to TABLE_VIEW; implement row count/cell attributes. (2) TableTwinView is a VBox of HBoxes (one node per row); virtualise before S4.5e timelines / S6.4-size tables. (3) PlotSource unplottedText is unused in production: the plot description and roving cursor should say N rows are not drawn (may fold into S4.6). (4) render() notifies TEXT on every render even when unchanged; diff first like MarkInputAdapter. (5) Columns equal-width vs board's content-sized columns; 'pinned · selected' annotation missing (Results board).
set.title: TableTwinView: TABLE_VIEW accessibility, virtualisation, unplotted rows announced
